table.retrieve:
SELECT saleinvcode = (dbo.saleledgermodified.saleinvcode),     
		 CustomerRef = max(convert(int ,rtrim(ltrim(IsNull(dbo.saleledgermodified.CustRefNo, '0'))))), 
       date = max(dbo.saleledgermodified.date),
		 invdiscperc = max(dbo.saleledgermodified.discperc),    
       flatdisc = max(dbo.saleledgermodified.flatdisc),    
       misccharges = max(dbo.saleledgermodified.misccharges), 
       invsalestax = max(dbo.saleledgermodified.salestax),
       remarks = (dbo.saleledgermodified.remarks),
       custcode = max(dbo.saleledgermodified.custcode),
		 looseqty = sum(dbo.saledetailmodified.looseqty), 
		 packqty  = max(saledetailmodified.packqty),  
		/* price = max(round(dbo.saledetail.packprice / dbo.saledetail.packunits,4)),	*/
       price = max(dbo.saledetailmodified.saleprice),    
       unittax=max(saledetailmodified.unitsalestax),
		 taxamount= max(saledetailmodified.unitsalestax) * sum(dbo.saledetailmodified.looseqty),
		 itemdiscperc = max(dbo.saledetailmodified.discperc),    
		 packunits = max(dbo.saledetailmodified.packunits),    
		 batch = max(dbo.saledetailmodified.batch),    
		 expiry = max(dbo.saledetailmodified.expiry),    
		 salestax  = max(saledetailmodified.salestax),
		 rowid     = max(saledetailmodified.rowid),
	 	 itemname = item.name,
		 /*datestring = max((Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(dd, saleledgermodified.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(mm, saleledgermodified.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(yy, saleledgermodified.date)))))), */
		 Person = (dbo.accounts.name),
		 contactperson=(dbo.customer.cp),
		 manufacurer = (dbo.manufacturer.name),
		 address = (dbo.customer.address1),
		 city = (dbo.customer.city)

FROM 	 dbo.saleledgermodified, 
		 dbo.saledetailmodified,    
		 dbo.item, 
		 dbo.accounts,
		 dbo.Customer,
		 dbo.Manufacturer 

WHERE  dbo.saleledgermodified.date >= :ad_StartDate and
		 dbo.saleledgermodified.date <= :ad_EndDate  and 
		 (dbo.saleledgermodified.custcode >= ( Case :al_CustCode When 0 Then 10 Else :al_CustCode End) and 
		 dbo.saleledgermodified.custcode  <= ( Case :al_CustCode When 0 THEN (Select max(custcode) From Customer) Else :al_CustCode End )) and
		 dbo.saleledgermodified.salecatcode IN (1, 2, 3) and
		 /*dbo.saleledgermodified.saleinvcode NOT IN (select distinct srledger.saleinvcode from srledger where srledger.originaldate between :ad_StartDate and :ad_EndDate and srledger.saleinvcode IS NOT NULL) and*/
		 dbo.saleledgermodified.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetailmodified.saleinvcode and  
		 dbo.saledetailmodified.icode = item.icode and 
		 dbo.saleledgermodified.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode and
		 dbo.saleledgermodified.custcode = dbo.customer.custcode and
		 dbo.Item.manfcode = dbo.manufacturer.manfcode
Group by 
			saleledgermodified.saleinvcode,
			saledetailmodified.icode,
			item.name,
			(dbo.accounts.name), 
			(dbo.manufacturer.name),
			(dbo.customer.cp),
			(dbo.customer.address1),
			(dbo.customer.city),
			(dbo.saleledgermodified.remarks)

objects.name: c_pagesum
objects.expression: Round ( cumulativeSum ( Round( (  looseqty   *  price  )  *  ( 1 -  (    itemdiscperc * .01 ) )  -  ( salestax ), 4) ) , 4 ) - Round( (  looseqty   *  price  )  *  ( 1 -  (    itemdiscperc * .01 ) )  -  ( salestax ), 4)

objects.name: c_cumulativesum_footer
objects.expression: Round ( cumulativeSum ( Round( (  looseqty   *  price  )  *  ( 1 -  (    itemdiscperc * .01 ) )  -  ( salestax ), 4) ) , 4 )
